rows.en: B-But… that would be the best Christmas present ever…
The genome of Fusion Steel… ugh… is still full of mysteries. There's a lot even I don't understand…
You can't die… Live, for my sake too! Keep up your research and save the EATERs!
I'm finished… More importantly… ugh… hurry, run…
Let go… of my hand…

No way!

Hang on! I'll heal you with my black magic!

…!?

No! That power is… the power that keeps the Vol cells… from killing off the eukaryotic cells…

In other words… a defensive instinct to protect itself by not killing its host…

Huh…?

Then I… you mean I could use black magic so that my Vol cells wouldn't die?

Ugh… That's right…

You should have been able to use it on yourself… and on every higher animal with eukaryotic cells… the ones that serve as food, so to speak…

No way…!

Then… when my pet hamster got better… and all the times I've been able to help my friends… that was me… because of my Vol cells?

Ugh… Now you understand… It's impossible to kill off Vol cells… Now, hurry… run…

My Fusion Steel… has lost its power… ugh… I might… I might end up…
Huh… this smell!?

Ah…

…………

We're stuck together!

I'm truly… truly sorry…

But… I'm going to… devour you…

…Run… away…
What is this…! Help me… [HERO2]…! Something's wrong with me…

[HERO4]!!

You're kidding, right? Stop joking!! What are you doing! [HERO4]!!

Damn it… How could this happen… How can something like this be allowed! [HERO4]!!
Atefarina the Battle Princess died having regained her human heart at the very end…
A breach opened in the impregnable fortress… a road to victory, opened at the cost of a precious sacrifice!
The warriors… holding their grief for a brave girl in their hearts, were about to face their final battle with the Steel Emperor!
[HERO4], the Space Sheriffs are assembling! Leave it to Annie!
So you've shown up, Destron!! Are you their new executive?
So you've shown up, Destron!! Are you their new executive?
That's right… Remember the name Marshal Armor!

The top executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker were always cyborgs!

And you're probably one too… Show your true form!!

The top executives of Shocker and Gel-Shocker were always cyborgs!

And you're probably one too… Show your true form!!

Our Destron has joined hands with the Battle Fleet Nation Naager to carry out the Operation to Annihilate Japan!

Shiro Kazami… no, Kamen Rider V3! And your foolish friends! I'll dispose of you all together! Gwaaaah…

Hessler!?

The Fushigi World Fuuma is just being used by the Naager! Don't you understand that?

Hessler!?

The Fushigi World Fuuma is just being used by the Naager! Don't you understand that?

Heh heh heh… Now, I wonder about that.

Maybe it's the Naager that's being used, after all? Fuuma's forces now reach across the entire galaxy…

What can mere Space Sheriffs do! Here we go! Subjugation!!

Hessler!?

The Fushigi World Fuuma is just being used by the Naager! Don't you understand that?
Gwah, gwaaaah…
Kuh… Nngh, Fuuma is immortal! Remember that!!
Playtime's over! Prepare yourself!!
Ultraseven… it's too soon for you to fall! Now, stand up!

Zoffy!

The first Ultraman, and Ultraman! I thought you both went back to the Land of Ultra…?
I'm sorry to have worried you… We went to the Land of Ultra to replenish our energy.

It's all right now…

Now, let's fight for the Earth! The Ultra Brothers, joining forces…
"Passed Stage 82… Emperor Guillotine destroyed" "Passed Stage 63… Iron Mask Party destroyed"
Defeat all of the BF's invasion robots and giant monsters!
Defeat all Iron Mask Party robots!
Defeat all Battle Fleet Nation Naager units and the BF's invasion robots and giant monsters!
Defeat all Battle Fleet Nation Naager units and Iron Mask Party robots!
Defeat Atefarina, all Gigants and Kelbaans, and the BF's invasion robots and giant monsters!
Defeat Atefarina, all Gigants and Kelbaans, and the Iron Mask Party robots!

Having finally cornered the wicked Steel Emperor Zephas, who skillfully manipulated the evil of Earth and of the entire universe to give mankind an eternal hell, the warriors were now about to face their final battle!
Director! Captain Kiriyama and the Ultra Garrison have just returned!!
Hmm…

And…?

The assault team… did those Amigo folks succeed in infiltrating the Space Fortress Naager?

Sir…

They succeeded!

The barrier was lifted, and some units succeeded in breaking in. We believe they're currently in combat inside the space fortress.

I see…

They really did a fine job! So our last prayers were answered, then?
Well…
What's wrong, Captain Kiriyama? Is something bothering you?
We've learned the objective of the Space Fortress Naager… no, of Steel Emperor Zephas.
What!?

According to what the Space Sheriffs reported to Commander Kom after storming the Fushigi Palace in pursuit of the Fushigi World Fuuma…

it's called the Gaia Project. Their final plan is to trigger nuclear fission in the Earth's ore deposits and turn the Earth itself into a bomb.
Ridiculous! Do they seriously think that's possible!?
No… In theory, it is possible.
What do you mean, Dr. Iwamoto…

Well… it's no exaggeration to say the Earth is made of stone, so to speak.

You can think of it as countless small stones piled on top of one another to make up this Earth…

And the core of this Earth made of stone… is made of iron.
Iron…?

That's right…

What would happen if that core of the Earth… the so-called metal core… were tickled a little with a substance that triggers a chemical reaction?

Treating the Earth itself as an explosive and detonating it wouldn't be all that difficult…
Then the Earth is…?
In an extremely dangerous state…

Still… Gaia Project is a fitting name.

The Earth truly is alive… They mean to define the Earth as a living being called Gaia, and then kill it.
But why? If they mean to destroy the Earth, wouldn't a planet-destroying weapon be enough?

Well…

My mentor, Dr. Hinata, had a theory that that Number Ten was also a living being…

Sadly, Dr. Hinata died in an accident during his research, but if his hypothesis was correct…

then Number Ten is unmistakably a living being, and you could even say it was our Earth that suddenly appeared before it.

You can't mean…!?

That Number Ten existed long, long before the Earth did…?

And that when we discovered and recognized Number Ten, it grew alarmed and launched a surprise attack… Is that what you're saying?
No… Perhaps it was we humans who grew alarmed and launched a surprise attack…

Wh-What are you saying?

Right now, we humans are facing the grave turning point of a final battle against the Space Fortress Naager's invasion, a fight for our very lives…

I understand how you feel…

But… what I'm trying to say is that there is no true enemy!

And if there is one, I'm saying it would be we humans ourselves!

After all, Steel Emperor Zephas is neither an alien nor a kaiju… he's unmistakably a human of Earth, isn't he?
Then… what on earth should we do?

Wait…

And quietly watch over them… Leaving the Earth's future in the hands of young people like them is the most natural thing.
It seems… all we can do is believe in them and wait.
Exactly…

This…

This is the Space Fortress Naager!?

In here… my father is in here! My father…
Even so… what an eerie shape it has!
Hmm… This substance corroding the hull… it might be a kind of iron bacteria.
Iron bacteria?
A type of prokaryotic cell with no cell nucleus.
Prokaryotic cells…? Don't tell me!? [HERO4]…

U13964: 改造人間 rendered 'cyborgs' here for flow; elsewhere 'modified human' may be preferred.
U13978: looks like a debug/branch choice row (stage 82 / stage 63); translated literally as two quoted options.
U13979-U13984: 大怪獣 rendered 'giant monsters'; ギガント, ケルバーン pluralized ('all Gigants and Kelbaans').
U14006: ナンバー・テン rendered 'Number Ten' (not in glossary). Dr. Hinata referred to as 'his' (male per glossary 'Dr. Hinata', scientist; gender assumed from 恩師 context – flag).
